055:1: On the worlds of light and life, reached at the end of the long struggle of evolution, how do death, government, and man himself change—and how far does that journey go?
055:4: In Paper 52 we saw how a world, through the visits of several Sons, comes to the threshold of light and life, and in Papers 53 and 54 we looked at the tragedy of Urantia, which stepped out of that procession. Now Paper 55 shows the destination toward which that whole journey moves. The era of light and life is the final evolutionary attainment of a world of time and space; it begins when the Trinity Teacher Sons complete their final mission and continues indefinitely (55:0.1-0.2).
055:5: Worlds settled in light and life are destined to go on through all the eternal ages of the future (55:0.3). This era unfolds in seven stages—planetary, system, constellation, local universe, minor sector, major sector, and superuniverse—yet any world may attain the planetary values of any stage regardless of other worlds or of the higher administrations (55:0.4-0.12).
055:6: How, then, do people live and how do they depart on a world settled in light and life? And what happens when such worlds gather one by one until the whole universe is settled?
055:8: On worlds settled in light and life, “funerals” are occasions of supreme joy, profound satisfaction, and inexpressible hope. (55:2.5)
055:12: The presence of a morontia temple at the planetary capital is the certificate that a world has entered light and life. The Teacher Sons preside on the day when “the holy temple comes down upon earth,” and the planet's Paradise bestowal Son comes in person to proclaim the Planetary Prince as Planetary Sovereign (55:1.1). The temple is said to “come down out of heaven,” but in fact the pattern designed at the system capital is brought by the morontia power supervisors and assembled on the planet (55:1.3).
055:17: The sanctuary of the Paradise bestowal Son
055:19: The Planetary Sovereign (formerly the Planetary Prince)
055:21: The acting chief of the planetary finaliters
055:23: This temple, which seats about three hundred thousand, is not used for worship or play but for special occasions: communication with superiors, ceremonies that make spirit beings visible, silent cosmic contemplation, commencement exercises, and recognition of merit (55:1.4). Above all, it is where living mortals are seen being translated into morontia existence, and because it is made of morontia material, it is not consumed by the fires of fusion (55:1.5).
055:25: Natural death is not the inevitable fate of mortals. Most of the advanced beings living in the last era of light and life do not die but pass directly from the life in the flesh into morontia existence (55:2.1). By the end of the Teacher Sons' last mission about one quarter are translated from among the living, and in the fourth stage more than half (55:2.2, 2.8).

Souls translated in this way bypass the mansion worlds and begin their service at once on the worlds of the universe headquarters (55:2.9). Yet so that no ascender misses anything essential to the journey, the seven mansion spheres give them the chance to master the skipped steps as both teachers and students (55:2.11-2.12).
055:42: In this age the world flourishes with one language, one religion, and, on normal worlds, one race. Still, it is not perfect: there are hospitals, and accidents and the infirmities of age still need care. Yet if we were suddenly carried there, we would call it heaven on earth (55:3.1). One first-stage world the author visited financed its public activities by tithing, with every adult worker paying ten percent of his income (55:3.2).
055:53: Provision for accident, sickness, old age, and disaster
055:55: The highest honor is the order of “supreme service,” conferred in the morontia temple, and most offices and judicial posts are held jointly by men and women (55:3.8-3.9). Even on such worlds there is still actual and potential evil to stimulate choice (55:3.10). The greatest obstacles keeping Urantia from this destiny are disease, degeneracy, war, multicolored races, and multilingualism, and no world can pass beyond the first stage until it has achieved one language, one religion, and one philosophy (55:3.21-3.22).
055:57: A settled world progresses wonderfully under the administration of a corps of volunteer finaliters, who, having attained Paradise, return to serve their brethren in the flesh (55:4.1). The liberated midwayers become interpreters for the finaliters, and thanks to discoveries in physical science, mortals too become able to see these once-invisible cousins (55:4.8). With each higher stage, the structure of government is readjusted in turn (55:4.3).

055:64: Life Carriers come as volunteer advisers to further purify the race
055:66: A new recognition of the Ancients of Days; a mortal chief executive appears
055:68: A Teacher Son and a pair of Trinitized Sons serve as advisers
055:70: Readjustments chiefly in the physical realm
055:72: Cosmic wisdom is added to the mind circuits
055:74: Superuniverse advisers join; Adam and Eve are always released
055:76: In the third stage the mortal chief executive governs the world together with the Planetary Sovereign for twenty-five years of planetary time (55:4.15). Adam and Eve, released from their long assignment, choose among several paths, such as beginning the Paradise career at once, or serving for a time as teachers or on the supreme courts and then receiving Adjusters (55:4.24-4.29). To receive the indwelling of an Adjuster on an evolutionary world, they must first become humanized (55:4.31).
055:78: The advanced stages of light and life are the culmination of evolutionary material development. Poverty and social inequality have all but vanished, and degeneracy and insanity are rare. War has become a matter of history; there are no armies or police, and self-control is making man-made laws obsolete (55:5.4).

055:82: The schools are devoted to training the mind and expanding the soul, and people compete to excel in the science and philosophy of cosmology. The pursuit of happiness is itself the experience of joy and satisfaction (55:5.5-5.6).
055:84: As society grows more peaceful, individuals become more altruistic and fraternal without losing their independence or their devotion to the family (55:6.1). Communion with the Adjusters grows ever deeper, and in the fourth stage there seems to be conscious contact with the presence of the Master Spirit (55:6.4).
055:85: Physical evolution is estimated to be complete about the end of the fifth stage, but wisdom is thought never to reach a limit (55:6.5). 055:91: When Urantia reaches this era, there is no doubt that Machiventa Melchizedek, now the vicegerent Planetary Prince, will become Planetary Sovereign. 055:93: When an entire system is settled, the Planetary Sovereigns become members of the system council, and the system gains virtual self-government. The System Sovereign is no longer replaced but remains forever the head of that system (55:8.3).
055:94: In this stage the midsoniters come for the first time as advisers. When the last system of a constellation is settled, the Most Highs are proclaimed unqualified rulers of the hundred systems (55:8.7).
055:96: When a whole constellation is settled, executive authority is newly divided, and many constellation and universe activities are moved to the system capitals. Some of the superuniverse administrators settle at the constellation capital as volunteer advisers to the Most High Fathers (55:9.1). Legislative functions cease, replaced by a council of System Sovereigns presided over by the Most Highs, who for the first time deal directly with the superuniverse government on matters concerning Havona and Paradise (55:9.2).
055:97: The Constellation Fathers take on more and more functions, gain almost complete autonomy in the sixth stage, and in the seventh are raised to the true dignity their name implies—the Most Highs (55:9.3).
055:99: When a local universe is settled, it is admitted into the superuniverse circuits, and the Ancients of Days set up a supreme council of unlimited authority. 056:1: How is a universe so varied, and at times so seemingly out of joint, held together as one in one God?
056:4: In Paper 55 we saw how the worlds settled in light and life move toward their completion. Now Paper 56 gathers up all those stories and speaks of the oneness that runs through the whole universe. Its first sentence is short and clear: God is unity, and the universe of universes is one vast integrated mechanism absolutely controlled by one infinite mind (56:0.1).
056:5: Because the perfect and the imperfect are truly interrelated, even a finite evolutionary creature can ascend to Paradise in obedience to the command, “⟦Q 56:0.1⟧Be you perfect, even as I am perfect⟦/Q⟧” (56:0.1). To the limited mortal mind the universe may look discordant and disorderly, but those who see more widely better recognize the underlying unity and single purpose beneath its diversity (56:0.2).
056:6: In what way, then, do matter, mind, and spirit, personality and Deity, and truth, beauty, and goodness each become one?
056:8: ⟦Q 56:9.14⟧God is all and in all, and no things or beings exist without him.⟦/Q⟧ (56:9.14)
056:12: The material creation is not infinite, but it is perfectly co-ordinated. Force, energy, and power are many, but their source is one. The seven superuniverses are seemingly dual and the central universe is triune, but Paradise is single in constitution (56:1.1). The Unqualified Absolute upholds the material universe, the Deity Absolute motivates the overcontrol of material reality, and the Universal Absolute functionally unifies the two (56:1.2).
056:21: Single in constitution — the actual source of all material universes
056:23: All gravity centers in the personal presence of the Paradise Father, the Father of pure energy and pure spirit (56:1.3). In the infinite nature of the Father there is no dual reality of the physical and the spiritual; in him all things hold together (56:1.4-1.5). But the moment we turn our gaze from that infinite level, we must postulate mind as the unavoidable technique for linking these two seemingly divergent manifestations (56:1.6).
056:25: The Thought-Father is expressed in spirit in the Word-Son and extended into the material universe through Paradise. What joins the two is the mind ministry of the Infinite Spirit (56:2.1). Because the primal thought of the Father was eternalized in dual expression—the Isle of Paradise and the Eternal Son—the existence of the Infinite Spirit, the God of mind, is inevitable (56:2.2).
056:27: ⟦Q 56:2.2⟧Mind is the indispensable channel of communication between spiritual and material realities.⟦/Q⟧ (56:2.2)
056:29: In time and space this infinite mind is bestowed as cosmic mind, reaching from the primitive ministry of the adjutant spirits to the magnificent mind of a universe chief executive. Yet even this cosmic mind is unified under the supervision of the Seven Master Spirits and is perfectly joined, through the Supreme Mind, to the mind of the Infinite Spirit (56:2.3). A material creature can recognize the indwelling spirit only through this ministry of mind (56:2.2).
056:31: Just as mind gravity centers in the Infinite Spirit, spirit gravity centers in the personal presence of the Eternal Son (56:3.1). The spirit of Paradise is one, but in time and space it appears in many forms (56:3.2). In the local universe the Holy Spirit and the Spirit of Truth go forth from the headquarters of the Creator Sons and, together with the adjutant mind-spirits, reach down to the lowest levels of material mind (56:3.3).

Personality by nature tends to bind all its constituent elements into one. Because mortal personality is likewise the direct gift of the Father, it has the potential to unify the many factors of its own existence. This unifying power is a birthmark of its high origin and evidence that it is linked to the Father through the personality circuit (56:4.2).
056:45: Philosophically we may, and indeed must, conceive of plural Deities and plural Trinities. But in the experience of worship, God is always one (56:4.5). Just as no child can have more than one father, to personality God can never be plural (56:4.4).
056:47: ⟦Q 56:4.4⟧To personality God cannot be plural. God is Father to each of his creatures, and it is literally impossible for any child to have more than one father.⟦/Q⟧ (56:4.4)

In the present superuniverses the Supreme Creators make up the first three levels of God the Sevenfold, and the whole is being co-ordinated in the evolving Supreme Being (56:5.3).

056:66: Evolutionary universes of time and space

057:4: In Paper 56 we saw that the universe of universes is unified as one in one God. Now, from Paper 57 on, we turn our eyes to the ground beneath our feet and look at how our own world was born within this unified universe. The story is told by a Life Carrier, a member of the original Urantia corps, on the basis of the records of the archives of Jerusem (57:8.27).
057:5: The author uses the current calendar with its year of 365¼ days, and says that even where exact dates are on record, he will not give them but will present the nearest round numbers. All dates are reckoned backward from the early twentieth century (57:0.1-0.2).
057:6: Through what stages, then, did a whirl of space energy hundreds of billions of years ago become a sun, then planets, and at last a sea waiting for life?
057:8: ⟦Q 57:8.26⟧These inland seas of olden times were truly the cradle of evolution.⟦/Q⟧ (57:8.26)
057:12: Urantia came from our sun, and our sun is one of the many offspring of the Andronover nebula. This nebula originated long ago in the universal force-charge of space in the superuniverse of Orvonton (57:1.1). The Master Force Organizers of Paradise had long held that space energy under their control, and everything began with the report of an inspector (57:1.2-1.3).

057:19: The Uversa Council of Equilibrium authorizes the dispatch of a force organizer

057:23: The mere presence of the force organizer and his liaison staff was enough to start the nebula rotating. Once the rotation began, they withdrew at right angles to the plane of the disk, and from then on the inherent properties of energy ensured an orderly evolution (57:1.6). From this point the story passes to the activities of the power directors and physical controllers of the superuniverse (57:1.7).
057:25: Every evolving material creation is born out of a circular gaseous nebula. In time it usually turns into a spiral, and it ends as star clusters or as a great sun with its planets (57:2.1). At this period Andronover, to the astronomers of neighboring universes, was simply an ordinary primary nebula with nothing special about it (57:2.2).

As it contracted and spun faster, the hold of gravity weakened, until at last suns began to be thrown off into space one by one (57:3.4-3.6). Most of the suns of Orvonton were born in this way.

057:67: Six billion years ago, as the terminal breakup came to an end, our sun was born—the fifty-sixth from the last of the second solar family. The suns that came from Andronover number 1,013,628 in all, and our sun's number is 1,013,572 (57:4.8). The nebula is gone, but its last nuclear remnant still glows reddish, sending light and heat to one hundred and sixty-five worlds (57:4.9).
057:69: Five billion years ago our sun was a comparatively isolated, pulsating variable star. This pulsation, swelling and shrinking in a cycle of three and a half days, made the sun very sensitive to outside influences (57:5.1-5.2). The unique origin of Monmatia, our solar system, begins here; fewer than one percent of the planetary systems in Orvonton have such an origin (57:5.3).
057:70: Four and a half billion years ago the enormous Angona system, centered on a dark giant, drew near. Angona's gravity broke off tongues of gas reaching out from the sun, and at its closest approach it pulled out a huge column of gas, pointed at both ends and bulging in the middle. This column became twelve planets (57:5.4-5.7). Angona drew this material out but could not carry it away as its own (57:5.8).

057:81: That is why the planets travel not in the plane of the sun's equator but in the plane of the protrusion drawn out by Angona (57:5.12). Retrograde motion always results from the collision of bodies of differing origin (57:5.13-5.14).
057:83: Beginning with the planets nearest the sun, tidal friction slowed their rotation. That is why Mercury and the moon always turn the same face (57:6.2). When a smaller body comes too close to a larger one, it is broken up by gravity-tidal action. The rings of Saturn are the remains of a shattered satellite, and the asteroids are a fifth planet that came too near Jupiter long ago and was broken up (57:6.4-6.5).

057:98: In the early days, with no atmosphere to protect it, meteors fell directly onto the surface of Urantia, and the heavier elements gradually sank toward the center (57:7.1). As the radioactive elements in the meteors were buried deep, internal heat increased, and true volcanic activity began. The radium clock is the most reliable method of dating, but because the radioactive materials near the surface arrived comparatively recently, all such estimates are too short (57:7.3).

057:107: The primitive atmosphere contained water vapor, carbon monoxide, carbon dioxide, and hydrogen chloride, but almost no free oxygen, because burning meteors and erupting lava kept using it up (57:7.6, 7.9). As the atmosphere cooled, the rains began, and for thousands of years the earth lay wrapped in a blanket of vapor, receiving not a single ray of sunlight (57:7.7). Oxygen accumulated only later, after seaweeds and plants appeared (57:7.9).
057:109: One billion years ago is when Urantia's history really began. The planet had reached roughly its present size, and about this time it was entered on the registry of Nebadon under the name “Urantia” (57:8.1). As the crust cooled and the waters gathered, a world ocean averaging a mile deep covered the globe. This first ocean was not salty but fresh water (57:8.3).

057:132: Mountain ranges arise not from the collapse of the cooling crust but later, from rain, gravity, and erosion (57:8.14). Even today Urantia has an average of fifteen earthquakes a day (57:8.15).
057:134: Paper 57 tells a long story spanning hundreds of billions of years as a calm chronicle. A force organizer set space energy in motion, the Andronover nebula gave birth to suns, the passing Angona system drew out our solar system, and meteors, volcanoes, and rain shaped the earth. None of this was a chance commotion; it was the normal preparation through which an evolutionary world passes, and all the while Michael was building Nebadon on the site of that same nebula. The history of the physical universe and the history of spiritual administration flowed side by side, until at last they met in the warm, shallow seas waiting for life. Those seas became the very cradle of our life.

058:1: When, where, and after what preparation did the Life Carriers plant the first life on Urantia, and how did that life spread?
058:4: In Paper 57 we saw the physical birth of Urantia—from nebula to sun, from sun to planet—down to the shallow seas waiting for life. Now Paper 58 tells the story of how life was actually planted in those seas. The author is a member of the Urantia corps of Life Carriers now residing on this planet (58:7.13).
058:5: On most inhabited worlds life is placed according to set techniques, leaving the Life Carriers little discretion. But about one world in ten is designated a decimal planet, where experiments that modify or improve the standard life are permitted. In all Satania there are only sixty-one life-modification planets like Urantia (58:0.1).
058:6: What, then, did the Life Carriers wait for, where did they plant life, and how is the history of that life recorded today in the rocks beneath our feet?
058:8: ⟦Q 58:4.1⟧Urantia life is unique, original with the planet.⟦/Q⟧ (58:4.1)
058:12: Six hundred million years ago a commission of Life Carriers from Jerusem began studying the physical conditions of Urantia, world number 606 of Satania. It was the six hundred and sixth life initiation in Satania and the sixtieth opportunity to modify the standard design (58:1.1). Life Carriers cannot begin life before a planet is ripe for it, nor can they develop life faster than the planet's physical development allows (58:1.2).
058:13: They had planned a sodium chloride pattern of life, so they had to wait until the sea water was salty enough (58:1.3). Even today the blood flowing in our bodies is essentially the same solution as the salt water that bathed the first cells (58:1.4). The commission returned to Jerusem to wait for further breakup of the continents, so that more inland seas and sheltered bays would form (58:1.6).
058:18: Waiting until it sufficed for sodium chloride life
058:20: Many inland seas, shallow waters, and sheltered bays
058:22: Waters 500 to 600 feet deep, with sunlight penetrating more than 600 feet
058:24: Rich in carbon—ideal for plants, impossible for animals
058:27: The atmosphere lets through to the earth only about one two-billionth of the light the sun gives off (58:2.1). The ozone layer, extending from about ten miles above the surface, would be only a tenth of an inch thick at surface pressure, yet it shields us from destructive ultraviolet rays. Had it been only a little thicker, it would have blocked even the ultraviolet rays essential to health (58:2.2). At night the atmosphere holds the heat like a blanket and protects life (58:2.5).
058:29: Your pleasant life on Urantia is due to the “fortuitous” influence of more than two-score apparently accidental protective operations similar to the action of this unique ozone layer. (58:2.4)
058:31: So the author says that the mechanists, who see material creation and human evolution as mere chance, lack imagination. The Urantia midwayers have collected more than fifty thousand facts of physics and chemistry that point to intelligent purpose in creation (58:2.3).

058:40: Grows hot again, reaching 1200 degrees Fahrenheit at the height of the auroras

058:44: The auroras are directly connected with sunspots. Sunspots, acting like great magnets, hurl charged particles out to the earth's outer atmosphere, and the resulting ionization produces the auroras. The slight swing of the compass needle eastward at sunrise and westward at sunset is also due to sunlight ionizing the upper atmosphere (58:2.7-2.9).
058:46: In early space great hydrogen clouds were scattered about, and these clouds were true cosmic chemical laboratories, holding every stage of the transformation of energy and matter (58:3.1, 3.4). The energy of the short space rays is four hundred times greater than all other forms of radiant energy in organized space (58:3.2).
058:47: Yet all this tremendous energy activity has no effect on the germ plasm of living beings. The life implanted by the Life Carriers was designed to be fully resistant to the flood of short space rays (58:3.4). Before life establishment could begin, these cosmic conditions too had to evolve to a favorable stage (58:3.5).
058:49: We should not be misled by the name Life Carriers. They did not carry life to Urantia. All life here was formulated right on this planet, and there is no other world in all Satania or Nebadon that has life exactly like Urantia's (58:4.1).
058:50: Five hundred and fifty million years ago the corps of Life Carriers returned and, co-operating with spiritual powers and superphysical forces, organized the first life patterns and planted them in the seas. All planetary life up to the days of Caligastia stems from these three simultaneous marine life implantations (58:4.2).
058:61: Planting in three places was a far-sighted plan. Even if the continents later drifted apart and great oceans came between them, each continent would carry its life along with it in its warm seas (58:4.4). By five hundred million years ago the primitive marine plants were well established, and the continents had begun their slow drift (58:4.3).
058:63: The earth's core has become dense and rigid like steel, and its central temperature is a little higher than that of the sun's surface (58:5.1). The outer shell, about forty miles thick, floats on a layer of flowing basaltic lava; without this cushioning layer, the world would have been shattered in great earthquakes. Earthquakes are caused not by volcanoes but by the slipping and shifting of the solid outer shell (58:5.3-5.4).
058:70: A little over five and a half times
058:74: The sea floor is heavy basalt and the continents are light granite, so the continents float on the sea floor and tend slowly to slide toward the sea. This is because the pressure of the continents on the sea floor is about 20,000 pounds per square inch, while that of the sea water is about 5,000 pounds (58:5.6-5.7).
058:76: Four hundred and fifty million years ago, in the shallow waters of sheltered tropical bays and lagoons, the transition from plant to animal took place. This development was all contained in the original life pattern, and the slime molds, which even today are hard to classify as plant or animal, remain as its traces (58:6.1).
058:77: Yet there are no links between the great divisions of the animal kingdom, nor between the highest prehuman animals and the dawn men. The so-called missing links can never be found, because they never existed (58:6.2). New species appear suddenly and fully formed, not by the accumulation of small variations, and this is not supernatural but wholly biologic and natural (58:6.3-6.4).

058:84: Bestowed by the adjutant mind-spirits according to brain capacity
058:86: Mind is not a product of physical evolution, yet it depends entirely on the brain capacity provided by evolution (58:6.7). All life moves back and forth in endless adjustment and readjustment; life that attains cosmic unity survives, and life that does not passes away (58:6.8).
058:88: The rocks of the life-dawn era, the Proterozoic, are exposed on about one eighth of today's land surface, with an average thickness of about a mile and a half (58:7.3). Here are found fossils of transitional organisms such as algae, coral-like plants, primitive protozoa, and sponges. The absence of fossils does not mean there was no life elsewhere; in early times life was scarce and spread slowly (58:7.2).

058:99: In this era life spread to all the world's seas, and the floors of the shallow inland seas grew thick with vegetation (58:7.11). This whole story is contained in the world's vast stone book, and if we only learn how to read it, its pages unfailingly tell the truth (58:7.12).

058:104: Paper 58 shows that life was not a seed that fell by chance but was planted after long waiting and careful preparation. The Life Carriers waited for the seas to become salty enough and for bays and lagoons to form, and, looking ahead to the day the continents would split apart, they planted life in three places. More than forty protective arrangements guarded that life, and it moved from plant to animal along the possibilities contained in the original pattern. And the story of that long struggle is still engraved in the rocks beneath our feet. The salt water flowing in our blood remembers that first sea, and the life of Urantia is a unique gift belonging to this planet alone.
